Subject: March 30th Iron Ore Cut Over




Shane,

On Saturday, March 30th, Iron Ore Australia will cut over iron ore supply from Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd to Aurum at the Warrawagine plant.

In order to accomplish cut over activities, we will need a technical representative(s) from Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd at the Warrawagine plant to participate in the activities and to insure Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd's interests and assets are protected.

Would you please make arrangements to have a Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd technical representative(s) report at 12:00 noon, March 30th, to the Main Guard House at the Warrawagine plant and ask for Iron Ore Australia's Ronald Martin.  Jorge is coordinating all the cut over operations.

If you have any questions about this, please contact me (at the numbers indicated below) or Ronald Martin at +61 8 9216 6911, ext 2511.

Thanks and best regards.

Howard
